headline: EarnIn Partners with Workday to Bring Enhanced Direct Deposit to Millions of Working Americans
summary: MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., July 29, 2026--EarnIn, a leading earnings management company, announced today a partnership with Workday, the enterprise AI platform for HR, finance and IT. EarnIn will be integrated into Workday’s Enhanced Direct Deposit Switching (EDDS) experience, enabling access to EarnIn’s earnings management tools for employees across the Workday ecosystem. Workday serves more than 11,500 organizations worldwide - including more than 65% of Fortune 500 companies.
